name: xai/grok-4.3
description: Grok 4.3 is a reasoning model from xAI. It accepts text and image inputs with text output, and is suited for agentic workflows, instruction-following tasks, and applications requiring high factual accuracy. Reasoning is always active and cannot be disabled or configured by effort level. It supports a 1 million token context window with no output token limit, making it well-suited for long-document analysis, deep research, and multi-step agentic tasks. Pricing is tiered: requests exceeding 200k total tokens are billed at a higher rate.
